title: StimulusEvent
description: One injected gamepad action from synthetic_gamepad.py's injector/holder log. Records the raw stimulus trace that was replayed, for noise-flagging correlation in the normalizer.

t_mono.description: Monotonic seconds (from synthetic_gamepad mono field) at which this action was injected

target.description: Button name (SOUTH, EAST, NORTH, WEST, LT, RT, …) or axis name (LX, LY, RX, RY, ABS_RZ, …)

value.description: Axis value for axis actions, duration_ms for press actions, null otherwise

note.description: Optional free-text note (e.g. 'down', 'up' sub-event of a press)
